about.title: A little about me
about.body: I'm a student at the University of Aizu in Fukushima, Japan, concurrently interning at 2WINS, Inc. and AVILEN, Inc. My interests live at the intersection of deep learning research and practical engineering — I like reading papers, reimplementing them from scratch, and shipping them as real services. Outside of ML I enjoy Kaggle competitions, reading, and contributing to open source.
